blockers.quote: Row three. The night batch. You, copying the topper's notes. Like every night.
blockers.why: story #2 Confirm the click: at 115 words a minute this line is the whole first 7 seconds, and it is only the copying. The thumbnail is the shocked face and the crimson 0.04% chip, and that pose does not arrive until line 20, about 11 seconds in.
blockers.fix: Every night, the topper's notes. Then yours: zero point zero four per cent. Put that thumbnail pose and the 0.04% chip on screen from the first frame, and drop lines 19 and 22 so the habit and the number both land inside 7 seconds.

suggestions.quote: You've been wearing the crowd's number. Like a verdict.
suggestions.fix: This is where I stop. After the one-in-a-thousand line the hall just sits there while 89, 90 and 91 explain the drop I already saw. Cut 89 and 90 ('But yours moved. Down.') and go straight to 'Copying their notes was never going to copy their number.'

suggestions.quote: Your own number moves. You've seen it. His... you just read.
suggestions.fix: I would pause here: the shot is his 0.2% chip, but the line says mine is moving. Replace with 'Yours has moved all month. You've watched it. His, you only read: zero point two.'

suggestions.quote: A year of fees. A year of your life. On one chair. So... keep going?
suggestions.fix: Move this ahead of the 2-second hold on line 29. The hold is still on screen at 0:30 and the year and 'keep going?' start just after it, so say them as the chair comes up.

keep.quote: You can't borrow someone's odds. Only their apron.
The biggest number? It tells you what's likely. It can't tell you what's worth choosing.
